law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 124/2024)
applies_to: Public & private controllers and processors (incl. foreign firms targeting Albania)
key_requirements: Data minimisation & lawful basis, data subject rights, local representative for foreign controllers, DPIA (from 2027)
retention_period: No longer than necessary for the purpose
penalties_range: Up to ALL 2 billion or 4% global turnover
exemptions: Household use; law-enforcement processing under separate rules
notes: Replaced Law 9887/2008; DPIA & prior-consultation rules apply from 17 Jan 2027
